title: Market Radar Events Feed

events.title: Google Releases Gemini 4 Neon: 61.4 AI Index & 1M Context at $3/$15
events.description: Google debuts Gemini 4 Neon tailored for code and agentic tasks with native 1M context, 145 t/s throughput, and 95% prompt cache read discount ($0.15/1M).

events.title: OpenAI Drops GPT-6.2 Astra & Astra Pro with 1.05M Context

events.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Cuts Input Rates by 80%
events.description: DeepSeek slashed on-demand API input rates to $0.022/M with prompt cache reads down to an unprecedented $0.004/M.

events.title: Gemini 4 Carbon Tops Artificial Analysis with 60.0 Index
events.description: Google pushes carbon architecture with 2M native context window without Tier-2 doubling fees, beating frontier models in throughput.

events.title: Claude 5.5 Deep Cache Expands to 95% Read Discount
events.description: Anthropic introduces adaptive TTL caching for Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5, cutting agent multi-turn conversation cost by up to 88%.

events.title: DeepSeek-R1 vs OpenAI o1: The 96% Reasoning Cost Showdown
events.description: Enterprise engineering teams report slashing math and code verification bills by 96% moving from o1 ($60/M out) to R1 ($2.19/M out).

events.title: Groq Offers $100 Free Inference Credits on Llama 3.3 70B
events.description: Claim ultra-fast LPU inference credits. Benchmark real-time voice and agent streaming with sub-200ms TTFT.
